datasets.title: SHAD leaf set: GEBCO depth (levels 11 to 15, 5577 cells)
datasets.description: Leaves of the tidal Scheldt, the Westerschelde and the sea, one HEALPix cell per leaf at its own level (zuniq ids, refinement_level null). Depth from GEBCO 2024; the leaf set is derived from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0). Also: wet_fraction, area_km2, is_river.

datasets.title: SHAD posterior: hourly probability per leaf, sigma 20 km/day (863 hours)
datasets.description: Hourly posterior probability of the position, one value per leaf (sums to 1 over the cells at each time), from 2023-05-03 11:00. Drag the time slider. Also posterior_s30 and posterior_s50.
